features.notes: SUPERSEDED / NOT APPLICABLE AS A SAMI KNOWLEDGE SOURCE (owner directive 2026-10-09). Dr Ahmed Hesham's workshops are never indexed into Sami's knowledge base and are never retrievable as teaching content. Sami keeps navigation and entitlement awareness ONLY: that the resource exists, its title and category, where it lives in the platform, whether the candidate's package includes it, and a deep link to it. It must not transcribe, index, summarise, quote, reconstruct or answer 'what did Dr Ahmed say in this session' from workshop content, and this holds even when the candidate owns the course - ownership permits watching the resource on the platform, it does not make its contents available to Sami for reproduction. Enforced at the RETRIEVAL layer by CompanionContentBoundary.IsProtectedType, not only as a prompt instruction. The former Stage 2 content-ops ingestion path for this source type is cancelled.
features.repo_evidence: Boundary implemented: `Services/Companion/CompanionContentBoundary.cs` (protected source-type fragments) applied in `CompanionRetriever` before entitlement scoping, so protected content cannot enter the candidate set; model-facing rules in `CompanionPromptComposer.AppendTeachingBoundaries`. Navigation metadata remains available via the `platform_map` source.
features.repo_gap: None outstanding as a knowledge source - the ingestion requirement is withdrawn by the owner. Remaining work is navigation/entitlement awareness only.
